notes: Shipped distrust list (eMudhra incident, October 2026). Every image build filters its trust bundle with it, every outbound TLS client checks verified chains against it, and posture findings cite it. Hashes are SHA-256 hex, lowercase: spki_sha256 over the certificate's SubjectPublicKeyInfo (catches every certificate for the same key), cert_sha256 over the DER certificate. Recomputed from crt.sh and the Alpine ca-certificates-bundle-20261020 on 2026-10-23.

entries.name: emSign ECC Root CA - G3
entries.reason: Root of the eight eMudhra intermediate CAs whose P-384 private keys are small integers anyone can recover (disclosed 2026-10-17). Removed from Mozilla's root store by NSS 3.131.1 (2026-10-20); Chrome removes it for clients without CRLSet on 2026-10-27.

entries.name: emSign Root CA - C1
entries.reason: Sibling emSign root removed from Mozilla's root store by NSS 3.131.1 (2026-10-20) with the eMudhra incident: the HSM key-wrap ceremony that produced the weak keys has no final root cause, so keys under this root are not vouched for.

entries.name: EM DV TLS CA - G3B
entries.reason: eMudhra TLS intermediate CA whose P-384 private key is the integer 156 (the public key is 156*G), recoverable by anyone; disclosed 2026-10-17, revoked by eMudhra on 2026-10-18 and by Sectigo on 2026-10-19. Matching by SPKI covers both certificates for this key: the one issued by emSign Root TLS CA - G3 and the AAA Certificate Services cross-sign. Go 1.26.10 carries the same SPKI in crypto/x509's distrust list.
